numeric: Accept JSON int/float except bool or decimal strings matching [+-]?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?; require finite Decimal value. Missing/null/other types invalid -> unknown. No exponent strings, whitespace or unit conversion.
dates: Strict YYYY-MM-DD and valid calendar; expires must exceed valid_from.

output.products: Exactly four unique input (id,revision), each candidate yes/no/unknown/error, recheck required/not_required/unknown/error, witness occurrence_id array. Empty witness unless yes; yes requires nonempty path.

extra_keys: No unknown output keys; optional diagnostics object permitted, never used to repair output.
failure: Whole-scene input/execution/schema errors retain 1 receipt,3 links,4 candidates,4 rechecks,1 graph flag as error; scorer uses frozen input universe.
